title: Fix a compile error
description:
The compiler refuses to build this program. Press **Run**, read the message in the **Problems** tab, fix the mistake and run it again.

When it works it should print:

```
Compilers are picky.
```
hints: The compiler points at the line *after* the mistake. Look at the end of the line above it.
Every statement ends with a semicolon `;`. One is missing after the `std::cout` line.
